life."],"alternatives":[{"meaning":"Death or the approach to death specifically, rather than hardship in general.","basis":["Psalm 23:4 is traditionally translated “the valley of the shadow of death,” code."],"prominence":"dominant"}],"has_settled_consensus":false,"confidence":"high","notes":"Christian preaching most recognizably uses “valley” as a metaphor for hardship or a spiritual low point,
